name: Escape the City
notes: Self-described '#1 purpose-led UK job board'; Hove-based, Certified B Corp. Strong fit for B Corps, social enterprises and climate start-ups. Built on Bubble.io and rendered in JavaScript, so there's no server-side HTML or feed to parse. Use the free account's job alerts plus the weekly 'Top 10 opportunities' email. Volume is moderate; quality is high.

name: Idealist
notes: Large non-profit/social-impact board, but heavily US-centric (the location filter only offers US-style mile radii). Algolia-backed JS search; a partner listings API exists but needs a key. Few UK design roles. Low priority.

name: Tech Jobs for Good
notes: Mission-driven tech roles; server-rendered HTML with params job_function, q and sort_by=date. Free tier showed 8 design jobs, with another 43 behind an 'Upgrade' paywall. Mostly US; London appears in the location dropdown but there were no UK design roles on 2026-10-13. Check monthly.

name: 80,000 Hours job board
notes: 936 jobs; Effective Altruism / AI-safety focused, with lots of London orgs but very few product-design roles. Algolia-backed (WordPress + Nuxt). Has built-in email alerts by category; use those rather than scraping.

name: Impactpool
notes: UN/NGO/EU international-development jobs. Rarely has product-design roles and is often field-based. Low relevance.

name: inClimate (formerly ClimatEU)
notes: European climate-tech aggregator with about 25k live roles, updated daily, including UK remote/hybrid and London roles. Filters: Function, Sector, Experience, Way of working. Non-paying users get a limited number of free job views; there's also a weekly 'Last Week in Climate' newsletter. JS-rendered with no public API, so use it manually or via the newsletter.

name: B Lab UK / B Corp directory (no jobs board)
notes: There is no UK B Corp jobs board: bcorporation.uk/jobs returns 404, and B Lab UK's page only lists its own vacancies. The old global 'B Work' board is gone (bwork.com no longer resolves). Most useful as a company-discovery source: filter the B Corp directory to the UK and add companies to the register, then monitor their ATS feeds. The directory is behind Cloudflare, so use it manually.

name: Work for Good (not a jobs board)
notes: workforgood.co.uk is a business-to-charity fundraising platform, not a job board. Excluded from monitoring.

name: Jobs for Good (UK)
notes: Holding page only ('SOMETHING IS HAPPENING!') on 2026-10-13. Re-check in a few months.

name: Do Something Good / Ethical Jobs UK / Good Jobs
notes: None of the obvious domains resolve (do-something-good.co.uk, dosomethinggood.co.uk, ethicaljobs.co.uk, goodjobs.uk), and searches found no live UK board under these names. Treated as not found. Escape the City and CharityJob cover the same ground.

name: Social Enterprise UK jobs
notes: Member-submitted social-enterprise vacancies; only 4 listed on 2026-10-13, none in design. Very low volume; a quarterly glance is enough.

name: Climatebase
notes: The biggest climate job board, with good UK coverage and Drawdown-sector filters; the sustainableux guide (2024) ranked it #2 for UX/product roles. It also hosts the Climate Designers job board. Every endpoint (pages, /api, robots.txt) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (403), so don't scrape or try to bypass it. Set saved-search email alerts (UK + Remote, function Product/Design) instead.

name: Terra.do climate job board
notes: Claims 88k+ climate jobs from 58k companies, so it's broad and partly auto-aggregated. Has a 'Design' function filter, a Remote toggle and sector filters. JS-rendered. Results are noisy (a 2026-10-13 search for 'product designer' only surfaced a volunteer graphic designer), so use it as a secondary manual check.

name: ClimateTechList
notes: Tracks about 9.7k openings, updated daily, with London/UK/EU location filters and params search, location, remote=remote-only and type. Jobs load client-side (Next.js); robots.txt allows everything but there's no public API (/api/jobs returns 404). Best used for company discovery: its companies mostly use Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby, which can be polled directly.

name: climate.jobs (Remote Climate Jobs)
notes: 871 live roles (48 added on 2026-10-13); path-based filters for /jobs/location/united-kingdom, /jobs/work-type/remote and /jobs?q=. Has a newsletter and a $5/month premium tier for early access. Smaller, but has a UK page that can be scraped.

name: Environmentjob.co.uk
notes: UK environmental/conservation board (171 jobs). RSS at https://environmentjob.co.uk/jobs.rss (the keyword param only partly filters, so filter locally). Mostly ecology and policy roles, with occasional digital roles at NGOs such as RSPB, WWF and the Wildlife Trusts.

name: GreenJobs.co.uk
notes: UK environmental/renewables board; RSS at /jobboard/xmlfeeds/jobfeed.asp?type=RSS. Mostly engineering, surveying and ecology; product-design roles are rare. Cheap to automate as a catch-all.

name: ClimateJobs.uk
notes: UK-only climate board; a JS SPA that only showed 'Loading site...' to non-JS clients. Volume unknown. Check manually now and then.

name: ClimateChangeJobs.com
notes: 30k+ roles, US-heavy; RSS at /rss/jobs (all jobs, so filter locally for UK and design). Also keeps a list of climate VC portfolio boards.

name: Green Jobs Board
notes: US-focused; the sustainableux review found zero UX/design hits. Not worth monitoring for a UK search.

name: CTVC (Climate Tech VC) job board
notes: Curated board run by the CTVC newsletter (originally on Pallet, now Kardow), with new roles every Monday alongside the newsletter. US-heavy. Better to subscribe to the newsletter than poll the board.

name: Sustainable Ventures jobs
notes: London climate-tech accelerator/workspace ecosystem board, built on Workable's job-board product. Job JSON is embedded in window.jobBoard.initialState['api/v1/jobs'], so it's easy to parse. Only 1 job on 2026-10-13; very low volume but very relevant companies. Its portfolio list is useful for company discovery.

name: Work on Climate
notes: Climate-careers community: free Slack with jobs channels that relay alerts from climate boards and member-posted roles, plus a monthly newsletter, office hours and starter packs. No standalone board (/jobs returns 404). Worth Robyn joining for networking and referrals.

name: CharityJob
notes: The UK's biggest charity board. Returned 8 'product designer' matches on 2026-10-13 (keyword match is loose: user researcher, BookTrust designer and so on). Cause filters via cause=. Has daily or weekly job alerts; no RSS. Results load inconsistently without JS, and scraping is probably against the ToS, so set two alerts ('product designer' and 'UX designer', Remote/London/South East) instead of scraping.

name: Guardian Jobs
notes: Madgex board with a strong charity/NGO/public sector mix; 5 results for 'product designer' on 2026-10-13. Search pages are server-rendered HTML. An RSS endpoint exists (/jobsrss/?keywords=...), but on 2026-10-13 it ignored keyword and sector filters, so either parse the searchjobs HTML or filter the full RSS locally. Email alerts are also available.

name: Third Sector Jobs
notes: Madgex charity board (it has carried Citizens Advice UX roles in the past). Bot-protected (403 for both curl and fetch), so use its email alerts.

name: Charity Digital jobs
notes: Small board for charity digital roles (e.g. Breast Cancer Now's Head of Digital Product on 2026-10-13). No RSS; has job alerts. Low volume but well-targeted.

name: JobTrain (charity ATS, e.g. Citizens Advice)
notes: JobTrain is the ATS behind many UK charities. Citizens Advice, which has a mature design team, posts product and human-centred design roles here (e.g. a 2026 'Human Centred Designer' at £41.7k plus London allowance). The listings page is server-rendered HTML that can be polled per charity. Treat it as company-level monitoring.

name: Goodmoves
notes: Scottish third-sector board; outside Robyn's geography except for remote roles. Low priority.

name: CAST (Centre for the Acceleration of Social Technology)
notes: Charity-digital org whose jobs page only lists its own roles ('no vacancies at present' on 2026-10-13). Its newsletter and network (Catalyst, Digital Candle) often circulate charity digital and design roles. Subscribe; don't automate.

name: Catalyst (tech justice network)
notes: UK tech-justice network (formerly the charity-digital Catalyst). No jobs board (the /opportunities page returns 404), but its newsletter occasionally shares roles. Optional.

name: Octopus Ventures talent board
notes: Getro board (network id 4580) covering about 175 companies and 826 jobs. The 'product designer' query returned 13 hits, 10 of them UK or remote (Skin + Me, Monq, Depop and others). It's a mixed portfolio (health, climate, fintech, consumer), so purpose has to be filtered per company. API: POST https://api.getro.com/api/v2/collections/4580/search/jobs with body {query,hitsPerPage,page,filters} and header Accept: application/json. Alternatively, server-side ?q= pages embed the results in __NEXT_DATA__.

name: Planet A Ventures jobs
notes: Getro (network 1426). Science-led climate VC based in Hamburg; mostly EU portfolio, with some UK/remote roles. 1 product-design hit on 2026-10-13. Cheap to poll via the Getro API.

name: Norrsken jobs
notes: Getro (network 4217). Impact ecosystem (Norrsken VC, foundation and incubator portfolios); 7 design-query hits, 2 UK/remote (e.g. Product Designer @ Vitala). Nordic-heavy, with some remote-Europe roles.

name: 2150 portfolio jobs
notes: Getro (network 1287). Urban-climate/built-environment VC with a London office. 0 design hits on 2026-10-13, but high purpose fit, so poll it.

name: Energy Impact Partners jobs
notes: Getro (network 253). Energy-transition VC with a London office; 46 design-query hits, but mostly US (3 of the first 20 were UK/remote). Filter on UK locations.

name: All Hands (civic tech) jobs
notes: Getro (network 634). US civic-tech and public-interest network, so most roles are US-remote. Low UK relevance.

name: Atomico careers network
notes: Getro (network 36986). Large general (non-impact) London VC network; 44 design hits, 9 UK/remote in the first 20. Purpose fit varies, so use it as a secondary source with sector filtering.

name: Kindred Capital jobs
notes: Getro (network 221). General London seed VC (equity shared with founders); 3 UK design hits (Scarlet, Paddle). Low purpose signal.

name: Balderton Capital careers
notes: Consider-powered board (board id 'balderton-capital'). The Consider API (POST /api-boards/search-jobs) needs a session CSRF token and returned INVALID_CSRF without one, so it's fragile. General VC, low purpose signal. Optional.

name: Climate Draft
notes: Was a Getro board covering about 10k climate VC portfolio jobs; acquired by Lowercarbon in 2023. jobs.climatedraft.org returned 404 on 2026-10-13 and the homepage is a bare shell. Treat as offline; the replacements are inClimate, Climatebase and the individual climate-VC boards.

name: Bethnal Green Ventures (portfolio, no jobs board)
notes: The UK's leading tech-for-good VC (around 170+ ventures: health, inclusive society, sustainable planet), but it has no portfolio jobs board (jobs.bethnalgreenventures.com and /jobs both return 404). Very high purpose fit: scrape the portfolio page once into the company register, then poll each company's ATS.

name: Pale Blue Dot
notes: Malmö climate seed VC. careers.paleblue.vc only lists the fund's own roles, and no portfolio board was found. Use its portfolio for company discovery.

name: Extantia Capital
notes: Berlin climate VC. The careers page covers fund roles only ('no open positions'); no portfolio board found.

name: World Fund
notes: Climate VC; its careers page asks candidates to email vacancies@worldfund.vc. No portfolio board found.

name: Giant Ventures
notes: London impact VC (climate, health, inclusive capitalism). Fund roles are on Workable and it has a Jobs-in-VC profile, but no portfolio board was found (jobs.giant.vc doesn't resolve). Use its portfolio for company discovery.

name: Zero Carbon Capital
notes: London deep-tech climate VC. A 'climate tech job finder' careers page used to list portfolio roles, but /careers and /jobs returned 404 on 2026-10-13. Use the portfolio for company discovery.

name: Kiko Ventures
notes: IP Group's cleantech arm. Fund roles are on join.com and Escape the City, and there's no portfolio board. Use the portfolio for company discovery.

name: Ecosystem Integrity Fund
notes: San Francisco sustainability VC; no portfolio jobs board found (jobs.ecosystemintegrity.com returns 404). US portfolio, so low UK relevance.

name: Systemiq
notes: Systems-change consultancy and investor (London). The careers page is Cloudflare-protected (403), and there's no portfolio board. It rarely hires product designers, but is high-purpose. Manual check only.

name: LinkedIn Jobs
notes: Highest volume. Don't scrape: it's against the ToS and returns 429 to automated requests. Set a daily email alert on this search (UK geoId 101165590, Remote+Hybrid f_WT=2,3, Associate+Mid-Senior f_E=3,4, newest first), plus a second alert with keywords like 'product designer' climate OR charity OR energy. Follow target companies so their posts reach her feed.

name: Indeed UK
notes: Bot-protected (403) and scraping is prohibited; its RSS was retired. Use saved searches and email alerts (London +50mi, plus 'Remote'). Noisy (recruiters, duplicates), but it catches charity and public-sector roles posted nowhere else.

name: Welcome to the Jungle (formerly Otta)
notes: Otta merged into WTTJ (otta.com now redirects to uk.welcometothejungle.com). Strong UK start-up and scale-up coverage, with company mission, values and remote policy tags. Algolia-backed, login needed for matching. Use the profile-based job matches and alerts (set preferences for climate, social impact and healthtech).

name: Work In Startups
notes: UK start-up board with a designers category. Bot-protected (403 for curl and fetch). Manual check or email alerts only.

name: Reed.co.uk
notes: Large UK general board. The free Jobseeker API (https://www.reed.co.uk/api/1.0/search?keywords=...&locationName=...) needs a free API key via Basic auth (returns 401 without one). Recruiter-heavy, but some charities post here. Worth automating cheaply. Search pages are also readable and surfaced junior/mid agency roles.

name: Adzuna (UK aggregator API)
notes: Aggregates most UK boards (including charity and public-sector sources). The free developer API (app_id + app_key) supports what_phrase, where, distance, max_days_old and category. Website search returns 403 to bots, so use the API. Good for automated breadth; dedupe against other sources.

name: Mind the Product jobs
notes: Product-community board with a Product Design category; 26 roles on 2026-10-13, with several in London/UK. Small but well-curated.

name: Wellfound (AngelList Talent)
notes: Start-up board; London product-designer page exists. Needs login to apply and filter. Medium–low UK volume.

name: Remote OK
notes: Global remote jobs; public JSON API at https://remoteok.com/api (terms require a followed backlink and attribution). Mostly US or worldwide roles that rarely suit UK hires. Optional.

name: We Work Remotely (design)
notes: Design-category RSS at /categories/remote-design-jobs.rss (on 2026-10-13 it included some non-design roles). Global remote. Low UK relevance.

name: Hiring Without Whiteboards
notes: A GitHub README listing companies with no whiteboard interviews (raw README can be parsed). Engineering-focused, so of limited use for designers. It's a company list, not a jobs board.

name: Dribbble Jobs
notes: Design-only board. The full RSS is at https://dribbble.com/jobs.rss; it ignores query params, so filter locally on 'United Kingdom', 'London' and 'Remote'. Mostly US, with a steady trickle of UK and remote-Europe roles.

name: designjobs.co.uk
notes: UK design board on Jobboardly, relaunched with free posting. Its RSS honours ?q=, and returned 5 UK product-design roles on 2026-10-13. Easy to automate.

name: UI/UX Jobs Board
notes: UI/UX and product-design aggregator with path filters (/design-jobs/london, /design-jobs/united-kingdom, /design-jobs/remote-united-kingdom, /design-jobs/remote-europe). Server-rendered. Aggregated, so expect duplicates of LinkedIn and ATS posts.

name: Design Jobs Board
notes: Webflow/WordPress design board, mostly US. Low UK relevance.

name: Women Who Design jobs
notes: Powered by Seeker; only 7 listings on 2026-10-13, all US or remote-US. Not worth monitoring.

name: UX Jobs Board (uxjobsboard.com)
notes: Shows 'Job board unavailable - Niceboard' on 2026-10-13. Defunct.

name: Creative Boom jobs
notes: UK creative-industry jobs (brand, graphic, motion), rarely product or UX. The site RSS covers articles, not jobs. Low relevance.

name: Design Gigs for Good
notes: Free community board for design and social-impact roles, posted to a public Google Group and a Slack (https://www.designgigsforgood.org/slack). The sustainableux guide (2024) ranked its Slack #1 for climate and impact UX/product roles, with 18 found. International, with some UK roles. No RSS (Google Groups feeds return 404), so join the Slack and enable notifications on #jobs.

name: Civil Service Jobs (incl. GDS / DDaT)
notes: Main channel for GDS, DWP Digital, HMRC, MoJ, DfE and other departments' Product, Interaction and Service Designer roles (DDaT framework; junior-to-mid roles are typically Associate/Designer grades HEO/SEO). The site has a 'confirm you're a real person' check, so don't scrape: create an account and set email alerts for 'product designer' and 'interaction designer'. Caveat: many departments now require 60% office attendance (about 3 days), which may conflict with Robyn's 2-day limit, so check each advert.

name: GDS recruitment page
notes: Explains GDS hiring; roles themselves are posted on Civil Service Jobs. Useful context, not a feed.

name: NHS Jobs
notes: Public XML search API at https://www.jobs.nhs.uk/api/v1/search_xml?keyword=product%20designer (no key needed; returns title, employer, salary, closeDate, postDate, url and location). Keyword matching is loose, so filter titles locally. Covers NHS England digital, trusts and some health charities (e.g. We Are With You). Easy to automate.

name: dxw jobs
notes: Employee-owned digital agency doing public-sector and charity work. WordPress jobs RSS at https://www.dxw.com/jobs/feed/, which is trivial to automate. Hires designers periodically.

name: Public Digital careers
notes: GOV.UK-founder consultancy. Uses Workable (account 'public-digital-1'), whose public widget API is https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/public-digital-1. Mostly senior consulting roles.

name: Public-good digital agencies (category)
notes: A category of employers to add to the company register and monitor through their ATS: Torchbox (B Corp, charity/NGO clients; Personio), Made Tech (public sector; careers page bot-protected), TPXimpact (B Corp; tpximpact.com/careers), Snook (public-service design, Glasgow/London), CDS (public sector), dxw and Public Digital (see their entries), and Citizens Advice (JobTrain). They regularly hire junior-to-mid product and service designers and offer real public-good impact.

name: Climate Designers
notes: Global community of creative professionals taking climate action, with local chapters and a Slack. Its job board is hosted on Climatebase (so it's behind Cloudflare) and it sends a weekly Jobs Newsletter. Robyn should subscribe and join the Slack/London chapter: high signal and good for networking.

name: ClimateAction.tech
notes: Slack for tech workers in climate (#jobs-and-volunteering) plus a newsletter. Mostly developer roles, with occasional UX/product (2 in the sustainableux count).

name: Women and Climate
notes: Slack community for women working in climate, with a jobs channel. Volume unknown. Useful for networking.

name: Creatives for Climate jobs & gigs
notes: Circle community board for climate creatives (bot-protected; membership needed). Leans towards brand, comms and creative roles more than product design.

name: Design Declares UK
notes: UK design-industry climate-emergency declaration and community. Doesn't list jobs, but signatory studios and agencies are a useful source for the company register.

name: Tech for Good Live
notes: Manchester tech-for-good community (podcast and events); no jobs newsletter found. Note that techforgood.global is now a spam site, so ignore it.

name: UX London
notes: Clearleft's conference (now at 2027.uxlondon.com). Its newsletter is about events, with no job listings found. Networking value only.

name: Ladies that UX (London)
notes: Community and meetups; no job board found. Networking only.

name: Sustainable UX - 'UX careers in climate' guide
notes: 2024 review counting UX/product roles per climate source (Design Gigs for Good Slack 18, Climatebase 11, Climate Draft 10, Idealist 7, Tech Jobs for Good 7, Terra 6). Links Nicole Kelner's 'So you want to work in climate' sheet (83 boards and communities). A meta-resource, not a feed.

name: Built In London / Bristol
notes: Tech job board with design/UX listings, level tags and 'posted X ago'. Good for junior and mid roles at startups.

name: Workable job search
notes: Searches every company that hires through Workable, including many charities and B Corps. Has a public search API that could be made automatic.

name: Totaljobs / CWJobs
notes: Search results readable; individual job pages are bot-protected, so roles found here are often marked Unconfirmed.

name: civiljobs.co.uk (Civil Service Jobs mirror)
notes: Mirrors Civil Service Jobs listings by grade (HEO/SEO = junior to mid). Useful because Civil Service Jobs itself blocks automated reading.

name: career.now
notes: Aggregator that surfaced some health-tech roles (e.g. C the Signs).
